notes.title: Patch V1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]We are happy to report that we fixed many issues in regards to:[/h2]
[list]
[*]-Minigames bug fixes
[*]-Main game bugs
[*]-Server bugs
[*]-Optimizations (the game runs much faster now with way higher FPS)
[*]-Game stability
[/list]

[h2]We also added full controller support[/h2]
The game is now playable with any joystick. 
[b]Full Steam Deck support is added as well[/b]
